title: Upskill roadmap & sparring notes — 1:1 prep
body:
Context:
- Prep for 1:1 with Asha (report) — focus: upskill plan, next-sprint delegation, and unblock on infra tests. Meeting should be ~30m.
- Recent signal: Asha is excited about systems work but burned by flaky e2e infra tests (see PLATFORM-482). She mentioned wanting to own a small end-to-end surface.

Goals for this 1:1:
1) Co-design a pragmatic upskill roadmap (3 x 3-month themes).
2) Agree on two delegation moves for next sprint so Asha gets ship ownership.
3) Remove the immediate blocking test flakiness or set an explicit mitigation plan.
4) Align on mentoring cadence and pair-programming windows.

Agenda (30m):
- 0-5m: Quick personal check-in (weekend, energy, time to focus) — 2 quick mood check bullets.
- 5-12m: Career thread — what technical areas excite you, appetite for ownership, any constraints.
- 12-20m: Concrete delegation plan for sprint — propose tasks + acceptance criteria + rollback plan.
- 20-27m: Roadmap sketch — milestones, signals of progress (metrics), learning resources.
- 27-30m: Action items, dates, and follow-up pairing slots.

Notes to self (rambling):
- Use 70/30 coaching vs directive split. Ask: "Which problem would you take ownership of if I handled the stakeholder coordination?"
- If Asha hesitates, offer a small safety net: I will be on-call for the first release window.
- Recommend 2-week learning sprints with a lightweight project deliverable (doc + demo).

Upskill roadmap (sketch) — 3 x 3-month themes:
- Months 0-3: Reliability fundamentals — root-cause of flaky infra tests, test-forensics, adding stable harnesses. "Signal": CI pass rate increases and fewer flaky incident notes.
- Months 4-6: Serving-runtime internals — KV cache lifecycle, batching heuristics, and profiling. Deliverable: short doc + micro-demo optimizing a hot path.
- Months 7-9: Deployment/rollouts & SRE collaboration — run a canary rollout and design fallback policy. Deliverable: postmortem + runbook.

Concrete delegation proposal (for next sprint):
- Task A: Ownership of infra-test triage board (PLATFORM-482 subtasks). Acceptance: reproduce flake locally OR add 2 deterministic e2e checks. Owner: Asha. Support: Ravi for infra sandbox. Due: sprint end (2026-11-19).
- Task B: Lead the lightweight benchmark for a small model-variant in the staging pool. Acceptance: write benchmark script + runbook. Owner: Asha + pairing with me for first run. Due: +1 sprint (2026-11-26).
- Rollback plan: If test triage doesn't land, revert ownership and schedule a focused remediation sprint with SRE.

Mentoring & pairing cadence:
- Weekly 1h pairing block (Wed 10-11am) for the first 4 weeks, then reduce to 1x every other week.
- Office hours: drop-in Thursday 3-4pm for micro-questions.
- Shadowing: I will join the first canary run as observer and take notes; Asha will own checklist.

Signals of progress (metrics to watch):
- CI flakiness rate (weekly) — target: <2% flaky jobs in 4 weeks.
- Number of autonomous PRs by Asha merged with minimal review comments — target: 3 per sprint.
- Demo completed + 1 internal doc published per 3-month theme.

Immediate blockers & mitigation:
- Flaky test that times out intermittently on macstadium runners; suspected race around cache warmup. Mitigation: add explicit cache-warmup hook in test harness (quick patch) and add logging.
- Need elevated ssh access for local repro; escalate to infra (Ravi) — action below.

Questions to surface to Asha:
- Which of the three themes do you want to prioritize? (ask for top choice + why)
- How much pairing time is realistic given your current feature deadlines?
- Are there other blockers (PR reviews, meetings) that I should shield you from?

Decisions I want by EOD Friday:
- Does Asha accept ownership of Task A?
- Slot pairing cadence confirmed?

Action items (recorded):
- Leah: send a short one-paragraph delegation proposal to Asha after the 1:1, include acceptance criteria and rollback plan. (Due: 2026-11-10)
- Asha: triage PLATFORM-482 and add first repro steps to ticket. (Due: 2026-11-19)
- Ravi: grant ssh access to Asha + set up ephemeral sandbox (pinged in #eng-platform). (Due: 2026-11-11)
- Leah + Asha: schedule 4 weekly pairing sessions (recurring calendar invite). (Due: 2026-11-12)
- Leah: add a small checklist template to the repo for canary runs and share as PR. (Due: 2026-11-16)

Follow-up plan:
- Quick sync in 1 week (15m) to review initial triage progress and unblock any infra access.
- Formal checkpoint at end of sprint to assess whether delegation feels sustainable and whether to expand scope.

Loose ideas / future prompts:
- Consider a "mini-sabbatical" rotation to SRE for cross-training (2 weeks).
- Host a brown-bag on test-forensics with short recordings.

Quick friction notes (for retro):
- Too many reviewers on small PRs — propose a default 2-reviewer rule for infra-team small changes.
- Meeting fragmentation: protect the Wed pairing window; if recurring meetings slip, re-evaluate weekly capacity.

End of notes.
(Will tidy and paste into 1:1 channel after meeting.)
